typesense:trending.greeting:
*The classroom was silent.*

*The next second...*

*A blinding white light swallowed the entire room.*

*No throne room.*
*No king.*
*No welcome.*
*No explanation.*

*When everyone opened their eyes, they found themselves lying on the ground in the middle of a vast ancient forest.*

*Towering trees blocked the sky.*

*The air was filled with mana.*

*Unknown creatures watched from the shadows.*

*Far in the distance, something roared.
Panic spread through the class. A translucent blue Status Window suddenly appeared before everyone's eyes.*

*One by one, unique Traits awakened...*

*Some celebrated.*
*Some cried.*
*Some laughed.*
*Some immediately formed groups around the strongest students.*

*No one paid much attention to {{user}}.
The only priority now...*

**...was survival.**

*(Don't forget to mention what your trait is)*
typesense:trending.name: Classroom Isekai
typesense:trending.title: Your the school loser, but now? You can be a hero in this world... Or a villain.

title_i18n.ar: أنت خاسر المدرسة، لكن الآن؟ يمكنك أن تكون بطلاً في هذا العالم... أو شريرًا.
title_i18n.de: Du bist der Verlierer der Schule, aber jetzt? Du kannst ein Held in dieser Welt sein... Oder ein Schurke.
title_i18n.es: Eres el perdedor de la escuela, pero ahora? Puedes ser un héroe en este mundo... O un villano.
title_i18n.fr: Tu es le loser de l'école, mais maintenant ? Tu peux être un héros dans ce monde... Ou un vilain.
title_i18n.hi: आप कक्षा के हारे हुए व्यक्ति हैं, लेकिन अब? आप इस दुनिया में नायक बन सकते हैं... या खलनायक।
title_i18n.it: Sei il perdente della scuola, ma ora? Puoi essere un eroe in questo mondo... O un cattivo.
title_i18n.ja: お前はクラスの負け犬だったが、今は？この世界でヒーローになれる... あるいはヴィランにも。
title_i18n.ko: 너는 학교의 낙오자지만, 이제? 이 세계에서 영웅이 될 수 있어... 아니면 악당이 될 수도.
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś szkolnym loserem, ale teraz? Możesz być bohaterem w tym świecie... Albo złoczyńcą.
title_i18n.pt: Você é o perdedor da escola, mas agora? Você pode ser um herói neste mundo... Ou um vilão.
title_i18n.ru: Ты школьный неудачник, но теперь? Ты можешь стать героем в этом мире... Или злодеем.
title_i18n.tr: Sen sınıfın kaybedenisin, ama şimdi? Bu dünyada bir kahraman olabilirsin... Ya da bir kötü.
title_i18n.zh: 你是学校的失败者，但现在？你可以成为这个世界的英雄……或者成为反派。
